relationships.subject: bradykinin
relationships.evidence_quote: an inflammatory soup of bradykinin, interleukin 1β (IL-1β) and tumour necrosis factor α (TNFα) sensitised TRPM3 function in isolated mouse sensory neurons

key_findings: Inflammatory soup sensitised TRPM3 in mouse sensory neurons; IL-1beta and TNFalpha but not bradykinin did so independently, without changes in TRPM3 expression.
Systemic TRPM3 blockade did not relieve CFA knee inflammatory pain.
